title: Advertisement for the post of Junior Research Fellow: 2 (Two)

source.name: A. C. Joshi Library, Panjab University, Chandigarh

text:
KEY LINES:
Qualifications: M.Sc. in Botany/Plant Sciences with at least 55% marks and NET
Age Limit: 30 years which is relaxed up to 5 years in the case of candidates

FULL TEXT:
Department of Botany
Panjab University, Chandigarh 160014, INDIA
Prof. Daizy R. Batish Tel. (0172) 253 4095
Principal Investigator E-mail: daizybatish@yahoo.com
Advertisement
Applications are invited for the following temporary position in the project entitled
“Assessment and Management of Neo-invasive Species for Native Plant Restoration in
the Vicinity of Developmental Projects in Himachal Pradesh” sanctioned by NMHS,
MoEF&CC, New Delhi, for three years (up to October 2027).
1. Junior Research Fellow: 2 (Two)
Fellowship: Rs. 37,000/= p.m. for 1st and 2nd year; 42,000/= p.m. for 3rd year
Qualifications: M.Sc. in Botany/Plant Sciences with at least 55% marks and NET
examination conducted by UGC/CSIR.
Age Limit: 30 years which is relaxed up to 5 years in the case of candidates
belonging to Schedule Castes/Schedule Tribes, Women, Physically
Handicapped and OBCs.
The position is temporary and co-terminus with the project or even before (at one-month
notice) if the work and conduct is not found satisfactory.
The complete application along with Bio-data, certificates / testimonials and experience
details / proof should reach the undersigned latest by January 23, 2025. The candidates are
advised to provide their email id and mobile number. The date of the interview shall be
communicated by e-mail.
The selected candidate shall be governed by NMHS and / or Panjab University rules and
regulations.
January 13, 2025
Daizy R. Batish
Principal Investigator
Department of Botany,
Panjab University,
Chandigarh
